verdict.rationale: Jeeves claims 'one-click sync with NetSuite, QuickBooks, and Xero', and transactions export with reference IDs and timestamps. That points to ERP integration that cuts manual entry, but the claim appears only on the Instant Pay marketing page. Nothing shows the sync is real-time or bidirectional; the real-time webhooks are developer notifications for card transactions, not an ERP connector. Missing for 10: evidence of real-time sync cadence, bidirectional data flow (e.g., GL/chart-of-accounts or vendor write-back from the ERP), coverage beyond Instant Pay (cards, expenses, bill pay), field mapping or journal-entry automation docs, and independent corroboration.
